source_text: The 293-bp fragment of the IIS6 domain spanning the kdr mutation site was amplified using primers Agd1 and Agd2 in 38 mosquitoes inclusive of six specimens which showed cross resistance to both DDT and permethrin exposure. Amplicons were sequenced... sequence analysis of the region spanning the kdr mutation in 38 of these individuals showed a complete absence of both the 'Leu-Phe' and 'Leu-Ser' kdr mutations.
